permitted_materials_used: the 21 anonymous crops generated from the assigned boxes

procedure.rotations: none; all principal writing is upright

notes: All 21 assigned crops have been read independently. Written short forms, underlines, parenthesized numbers, formulas, punctuation and insertion attachment are preserved. No witness, first-pass record, report, candidate list or comparison material was opened. The principal unresolved issues are a compact index, faint traces before définissant, and the overwritten final word and its abbreviated replacement.

boxes.scope: The complete upper author folio.
boxes.evidence: The first digit is angular with a low right stem, and the second has two crossing loops: 48.

boxes.scope: The complete principal phrase; the clipped stroke at the top belongs to the preceding line.
boxes.evidence: des has a looped d and low es. actions has the crossed tall t and compact ion/s ending. Gamma has a separate prime. The final pi has two uprights beneath its top bar, followed by a distinct round full stop.

boxes.scope: The complete parenthesized short form and following words. The parenthesis continues outside the box; no close is supplied.
boxes.evidence: The large M has an independent flat bar directly above it. The following word starts with a low c, then tall h, round o and low se, read chose. d’ailleurs has the apostrophe and two tall l strokes.
boxes.uncertainty: The barred M is retained as the written short form without expansion; the reading does not normalize it to a spelled-out word.

boxes.scope: The full K, quand on regarde passage.
boxes.evidence: K has two separate right arms and a comma. quand has the q descender and terminal tall d. The two low on traces precede regarde, with a large g loop and later tall d. No final punctuation is visible.

boxes.scope: The complete parenthesized reference.
boxes.evidence: Both parentheses enclose a curved 2 and a looped 9 with descending stem: (29).

boxes.scope: The complete E expression and following comma. Top strokes are neighboring-line context.
boxes.evidence: The main E has its upper and lower curves. Its smaller k has an upright and branching right strokes. The comma is separate at the lower right; there is no bar over E or its index.

boxes.scope: The whole two-level insertion; clipped source-line strokes at the top are excluded.
boxes.evidence: ou is underlined once. sous-groupes has a distinct hyphen, followed by ouverts with its tall t. Gamma has a separate prime. The smaller continuation reads de ceux-ci, with a hyphen and dotted i, and ends in a comma.
boxes.attachment: The long leader runs beneath the insertion and reaches the source position before en les composant, after the preceding E_k comma. Its curve is not an opening parenthesis.

boxes.scope: The full main clause en les composant. The leader above and its curved left segment are nontextual attachment marks.
boxes.evidence: les has a tall l loop; composant has the p descender and terminal tall crossed t. A separate dark full stop follows it. No opening parenthesis is read from the leader.

boxes.scope: The two complete principal words.
boxes.evidence: avec has a small open a-form, a compact v and low ec continuation. des has a looped d and low es. The faint isolated left-edge spot is not confidently punctuation.

boxes.scope: The entire E expression and following dash.
boxes.evidence: The main letter has the two E curves. The low index has a tall first stroke and joined arch/right return. At the right, a short dark part and a longer pale horizontal part lie on approximately one level, read as a dash rather than equality.
boxes.uncertainty: k is preferred for the index, but the compact joining can also look n-like. The full formula is recorded with that local uncertainty.

boxes.scope: The complete principal des sous-groupes formula line; clipped upper context is excluded.
boxes.evidence: A short hyphen follows the low sous letters. groupes has its large g loop and p descender. Gamma-prime precedes a C-shaped inclusion sign and E with small k, followed by a distinct full stop.

boxes.scope: The complete lower E_{k(s)}, defining phrase, and the whole interlinear définie par (29). Clipped famille writing at the top is excluded.
boxes.evidence: The field index shows k, an opening parenthesis, s and closing parenthesis. The source comma follows the insertion leader. The added word has d, accented e, a long f descender and dotted i strokes; par and (29) are clear. The main word définissant has its large f, dotted i forms and tall terminal t.
boxes.attachment: The leader starts after the E expression and before its source comma; the inserted reference itself has no independent final comma. The hook at the far right belongs to the leader.
boxes.uncertainty: Immediately before the dark définissant are very faint looped strokes, tentatively le or re. Their status as live writing, an abandoned trace, or show-through is unresolved; the TSV retains an explicit doubt and does not treat them as securely readable prose. The main defining phrase and attachment are high confidence.

boxes.scope: The complete word.
boxes.evidence: Two distinct tall f stems with long descending strokes are followed by low ec, a crossed t, dotted i and ves ending: effectives. No following punctuation is visible.

boxes.scope: The complete final short form and closing parenthesis; a clipped preceding-word fragment at the far left is excluded.
boxes.evidence: An e-like open curve is followed by crossed x and tall crossed t, then a separate closing parenthesis. No abbreviation full stop is independently visible. The short form ext is not expanded.

boxes.scope: Both complete words and the comma.
boxes.evidence: The first word has c and low es; the second has a looped d, the compact er/ni middle, a dot over i, and terminal ers. A separate comma follows: ces derniers,

boxes.scope: The complete field expression and verb. Clipped upper-line fragments are excluded.
boxes.evidence: k(s) is followed by a low n and raised apostrophe. apparaissent has two long p descenders, low intervening letters, a dotted i and tall terminal t. The ending is read -issent, not supplied from grammar. No final punctuation is visible.

boxes.scope: The complete principal word; clipped lower-line fragments are excluded.
boxes.evidence: The word has a p descender, tall l loop, low u, and two crossed t stems. A separate short raised stroke sits above the o position.
boxes.uncertainty: The accent is a flattened short stroke; it is transcribed as the written accent in plutôt, not supplied from a blank area.

boxes.scope: The whole quotient formula.
boxes.evidence: The O has an independent horizontal underline and a low s to its right. A single oblique quotient slash precedes a three-stroke m form with its own low s. There is no independently visible bar beneath the denominator.

boxes.scope: The complete principal phrase and punctuation; the p descender approaches the lower crop edge but the word is readable.
boxes.evidence: sous-anneaux has a distinct hyphen and crossed final x. Two separate vertically placed marks follow it, the upper slightly brown and the lower dark, read as a colon. Cependant begins with a large C, contains its p descender and tall d/t forms, and ends with a separate comma.

boxes.scope: The complete S de dim ... sur passage and both revision levels. Upper right clipped context is excluded.
boxes.evidence: The main phrase has S, de, and dim with a dotted i and no independent abbreviation stop. A horizontal strike crosses the lower word, whose i dots and low ending permit finie. Above it are a long descending initial q-like stroke, a tall l loop, then c/o/n-like low forms and a short final upright, tentatively qlconq. sur follows on the source baseline.
boxes.uncertainty: The lower finie and upper short form qlconq are both retained under doubt because their tall strokes overlap and the final q-like mark has a very small head. The short form is not expanded.
boxes.attachment: The upper short form replaces the cancelled lower word after dim and before sur.

boxes.scope: The complete bottom-left marginal folio.
boxes.evidence: The first digit has a closed upper loop and descending tail; the second has a tall curved stem and closed lower loop: 96. Image borders are excluded.
